name: Temporal Wind's Eulogy
title: Venti: Temporal Wind's Eulogy
desc: "Therefore, the so-called 'Unrevealed' can mean only two things: a future not anchored by the stars, or one deliberately obscured by those with ill intentions. The latter is truly infuriating. I do hope the little witch in the story never becomes someone like that."
in_play_description: After you summon Stormeye, the attached character's Physical DMG is converted to Anemo DMG for their next two Normal Attacks during this Round, and these attacks cost 2 fewer Unaligned Element.

skills.desc:
Fast Action: Equip this to your Venti.
Summon Stormeye.
After you summon Stormeye, the attached character's Physical DMG is converted to Anemo DMG for their next two Normal Attacks during this Round, and these attacks cost 2 fewer Unaligned Element.
(You must have Venti in your deck to add this card to your deck.)
